title: Welcome to the Delta
voiceover: The sea took the world we knew. The crops failed, and what's left of humanity now survives on a synthetic food gel. On one side of the Bulwark, the ocean; on the other, five hundred million people, and not one meal grown in soil.
close: The Drowned Concordat is about what happens when the people running the system don't understand the people they govern. Book One is out now on Kindle.
teaser: The crops failed, and what's left of humanity survives on a synthetic food gel.

title: Food from a vat
voiceover: Imagine never tasting food that grew in the ground. Not once, in your whole life. In the Delta, breakfast is gel, lunch is gel, dinner is gel. Foam or lump: that's the choice.
close: The Drowned Concordat asks what you would believe in, if your next meal depended on it. Book One is out now.
teaser: Imagine never tasting food that grew in the ground.

title: Meet Elara
voiceover: Doctor Elara Di Canti keeps a drowned hemisphere fed. She has never doubted that it's worth it. High above the flood line, the towers glow. Far below, the queues for gel never end.
close: Elara believes in the system. The Drowned Concordat is about what that belief costs. Book One, out now on Kindle.
teaser: Doctor Elara Di Canti keeps a drowned hemisphere fed.

title: Why a wall?
voiceover: People ask me, why a wall? Because when the water came, a wall was the only promise anyone could keep. Storm season on the Bulwark. Every wave is a test the engineers have to pass. And the ocean is patient.
close: The Drowned Concordat. Climate fiction where the flood has already happened. Book One is out now.
teaser: People ask me, why a wall? Because when the water came, a wall was the only promise anyone could keep.

title: Every calorie counted
voiceover: In the Delta, every calorie is counted. Every gram is accounted for. And so is everyone who eats one. The Council keeps the Delta fed. The Enforcers keep it quiet.
close: If the oceans rose tomorrow, who would decide what you eat? The Drowned Concordat, Book One, out now.
teaser: In the Delta, every calorie is counted.

title: Two sisters, one drowned world
voiceover: Two sisters, one drowned world, and two very different ideas of how to save it. Elara feeds the Delta from a vat. Her sister Becca still believes the future grows in soil.
close: That argument sits at the heart of The Drowned Concordat. Book One is out now on Kindle.
teaser: Two sisters, one drowned world, and two very different ideas of how to save it.

title: When the food comes from a vat
voiceover: Some people in the Delta have stopped trusting the numbers. A few have started to pray instead. When your food comes from a vat, faith has to come from somewhere else.
close: The Drowned Concordat is about food, faith, and the people who keep a drowned world alive. Book One, out now.
teaser: Some people in the Delta have stopped trusting the numbers.

title: If you loved Station Eleven
voiceover: If you love Station Eleven, The Water Knife or The Wind-Up Girl, this one is for you. A hard science fiction dystopia, set behind the sea walls of a flooded Europe.
close: The Drowned Concordat, Book One. Out now on Kindle. Come and see what's left.
teaser: If you love Station Eleven, The Water Knife or The Wind-Up Girl, this one is for you.
